display_name: Prepared (peacetime) position: emplacement, camouflage nets, wire, dummy positions
status: Numbers for simcore/position_prep.hpp (roadmap 7.6). That prepared positions had concrete emplacements, two rows of wire, camouflage nets, dummy positions, smoke generators and decoys is from video_osa (tier 4, unverified); the Angola memoir in korovin_tiv_2010 has the vehicles in 2 m deep emplacements under nets. No source gives how much they hide a vehicle from a radar: those factors are estimates, labelled so.
notes: An RCS factor multiplies the vehicle's echo seen by the other side's radars (the EM layer's ground platform). A dummy position is a ground echo of its own (corner reflectors) and, if the scenario asks, a decoy emitter copying the search radar (roadmap E7).

vehicle_rcs_m2.source: estimate (a tracked or wheeled armoured vehicle's radar echo is of the order of 10-30 m2 from the side)

emplacement_rcs_factor.source: estimate (the hull below ground level in the emplacement: korovin_tiv_2010, 2 m deep; only the turret and antennas show)

nets_rcs_factor.source: estimate (camouflage nets over the vehicle: video_osa; the radar-scattering effect is not documented)

dummy_rcs_m2.source: estimate (corner reflectors sized to look like the real vehicle; video_osa: dummy positions and decoys)

leave_emplacement_s.source: estimate (climbing out of the emplacement and clearing the nets before driving off)
